generation_methodology: Programmatic template generation: 9 core adversarial families (operative, descriptive/background, negated, conditional, exception/carve-out, cross-reference-dependent, definition-dependent, ambiguous/competing-conflicting, missing-clause) x 12 adapters x 6 distinct party-name pairs (Provider/Recipient, Contractor/Client, Licensor/Licensee, Supplier/Buyer, Operator/Subscriber, Company/Counterparty), each instantiated with genuinely varied numeric/detail parameters (day counts, dollar amounts, percentages, multipliers, jurisdictions, exhibit/schedule labels) so no two cases are near-duplicates beyond sharing a family shape. Plus 12 hand-authored composite/whole-document cases covering three real interaction-engine scenarios (each scored from both participating adapters), unusual drafting order, role ambiguity, asymmetric obligations, a deliberately clean agreement, a deliberately unsafe agreement, and a whole-document conflicting-provisions case. Every sentence was freshly authored for this corpus.
expected_result_methodology: Expected labels use the SAME 8-value vocabulary already validated across three prior burned corpora and re-used here as a scoring RUBRIC only (YES_OPERATIVE, NO_NOT_OPERATIVE, YES_BUT_CONDITIONAL, YES_BUT_EXCEPTION, AMBIGUOUS, CROSS_REFERENCE_DEPENDENT, DEFINITION_DEPENDENT, MISSING_CLAUSE), graded via the same established_signal/_grade logic already used in replay_final_gap_closure.py (unmodified, imported as-is). Each case was labeled by the same deterministic linguistic shape used to author it (e.g. a case authored with a definition-dependent proposition is labeled DEFINITION_DEPENDENT) -- not by running it against Candidate 3 first and back-labeling the result, which would defeat the purpose of an independent corpus.
contamination_checks: No case text appears in the burned 74-case corpus (artifacts/candidate2_remediation).
No case text appears in the burned 240-case corpus (artifacts/candidate3_real_ai_adversarial/corpus/cases.py).
No case text is copied or derived from any adapter unit-test fixture under tests/.
No case text is copied or derived from any prior repeatability fixture (artifacts/candidate3_zero_silent_loss/repeatability/, artifacts/candidate3_final_gap_closure/repeatability/).

ip_ownership-080 (and its exact failure-shape phrasing, "shall be owned exclusively by X upon Y") is explicitly excluded -- ip_ownership cases in this corpus use a structurally different ownership-transfer construction ("owns all right, title, and interest" / "title shall transfer to X upon Y") that does not reproduce the deferred defect's literal trigger phrase.

This corpus was constructed without inspecting any Candidate 3 failure log, burned-corpus case text, or repeatability result file for content ideas -- only the scoring rubric (label vocabulary + grading function) was reused, which is the correct, sound approach for an independent validation corpus.
